original.target_description: Independent age-group t-test of EmpaToM compassion ratings in final younger and older adult groups.

n.sample_role: Participants in independent compassion age-group t-test: 55 younger and 52 older adults in mutually exclusive final groups.
n.exclusions: 15 excluded: 6 older adults for MOCA <25; 2 younger and 2 older adults for psychiatric condition/treatment; 3 older adults for neurological conditions; 2 older adults for below-chance performance. No additional target-test exclusions stated.
n.location: Methods, Participants, final effective sample and exclusions; Results, No Age Differences in Empathy and Positive Age Differences in Compassion; Methods, Data analysis
n.quote: A total of 15 participants were excluded from the final data analysis due to the following a priori exclusion criteria: dementia screening based on the Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MOCA27 with a score below 25 points (n = 6 OA)), self-report of a current psychiatric condition or of being in psychotherapeutic or psychopharmacological treatment (n = 2 YA, n = 2 OA), any present or past neurological conditions (n = 3 OA, stroke or Morbus Parkinson), below chance level (<0.33) performance (n = 2 OA). ... Altogether, the final effective sample included 55 younger adults (mean age = 24.29 years, SD = 3.09 years, 31 female) and 52 older adults (mean age = 72.08 years, SD = 3.76 years, 30 female).

notes: Identity assessment: exact referenced title and complete primary empirical report (Results, Methods, Discussion, Author Contributions), not an abstract-only excerpt, secondary article or preregistration. Author initials A.M.F.R., P.K., B.E., S.C.L. are consistent with reference authors. Full byline and DOI are absent from the supplied canonical text and could not be independently checked. Source provenance header is Europe PMC fullTextXML. No PDF supplied; locations use sections rather than visually verified page numbers. Only assigned unfinished fields evaluated; other fields are placeholders. 55 younger participants + 52 older participants = 107 final analytic participants. Excluded: 6 OA dementia screening + 2 YA psychiatric + 2 OA psychiatric + 3 OA neurological + 2 OA below-chance = 15. Recruitment totals and df were not used to derive N. These explicitly final, mutually exclusive age groups are compared in the target test; no additional test-specific exclusion is stated. Critical-test evidence: Regarding these compassion ratings, an independent t-test showed significant age differences (t(82.74) = 5.20, p < 0.001, Cohen’s d = 0.99); older adults indicated higher ratings of compassion than younger adults (Fig. 3b). The fractional t-test df are not used to derive N.
